input.money: signed 64-bit integer cents; no floating-point money
input.shipping_before_ddl: missing nullable field is projected as zero

consistency.source: InnoDB REPEATABLE-READ transactions, verified from effective server isolation; each mutation includes an atomic operation receipt
consistency.sink: eventually convergent current table at a fenced source/input/output cut
consistency.live_reads: exact historical immutable rows; sampled acknowledged inserts may remain pending during pipeline lag

ordering.key: JSON order_id with Kafka's default keyed partitioner
ordering.target_version: Kafka offset, only while each order remains in one fixed partition
ordering.partition_expansion: not qualified; requires a migration/version design
ordering.updates: Flink emits delete/insert pairs; business revision alone cannot order identical-revision pairs

durability.flink_output: checkpointed Kafka transactions; consumer read-committed behavior is independently probed
durability.checkpoint_storage: owned local shared Docker volume; two retained checkpoints, not an independent backup
durability.witness: external intent/ACK JSONL with fsync, surviving component faults; no physical power-loss claim

retries.business_mutations: none; a commit error remains ambiguous until reconciled
retries.backfill_signal: reuse the same primary-key identity; reject conflicting type/content
retries.target: latest committed keyed changelog offset; retain delete tombstones
retries.airflow: one task retry, same DAG run identity

delete_and_ttl.target: logical absence in the current view; raw CDC and tombstones remain
delete_and_ttl.ttl: not exercised; no claim of physical erasure or bounded whole-history retention

fault_expectations.source_progress_during_hold: at least five additional transaction ACKs
fault_expectations.recent_insert_after_recovery: a newly observed sampled ACK becomes visible within 180 seconds
fault_expectations.final_cut: all eleven output fields and EOF match source SQL on each fixed replica

performance: Level 3 recovery/operation diagnostics; no exhaustive matrix or capacity winner
isolation: local internal Docker network, owned static credentials, no real AWS configuration/resources or hosted exports
